privacy: No profile values, IDs, credentials, free text or schedules in event parameters.

web_cta_click.meaning: Open web product CTA; intent only

app_store_click.meaning: Store link click; not an installation

login.meaning: Interactive authentication success; not token refresh

sign_up.meaning: Account signup API success; not profile updates
sign_up.web_coverage: password signup only; social profile flow requires reliable new-account signal

ward_created.meaning: Create ward or complete onboarding draft API success; existing linked ward is excluded

schedule_confirmed.meaning: Snapshot publish API success; repeated confirmations are repeated events, not first activation

tutorial_complete.meaning: Intro marked complete locally; not clinical onboarding or ward setup

parameters.method: controlled authentication method; never email or user ID

analysis.acquisition: GA source/medium + Search Console query/page; exact .ai hostname filter
analysis.activation: Ordered user funnel sign_up -> ward_created -> schedule_confirmed; do not divide event counts
analysis.retention: User cohort return activity after activation; requires sufficient post-release history
quality_checks: event coverage and missing success events
